description: Play Console Data safety form answers aligned with analytics consent, optional cloud sync, Autobackup excludes, and privacy.html. No PII claims.

overview.collectsNote: Only after optional opt-in: privacy-safe analytics events and/or anonymous cloud save sync. Core play works fully offline with both off.
overview.deletionHow: Turn analytics/cloud off in Settings; clear app storage / uninstall. Optional cloud snapshots are tied to an anonymous Firebase uid — disable cloud sync and clear app data; contact via Support for account-linked snapshot removal when Firebase is configured.
overview.familiesNote: Content rating Everyone; not enrolled in Designed for Families.

dataCollected.notes: Allowlisted events only after analytics consent: tutorial_step_completed, first_sale, harbor_unlocked, offline_claimed, save_recovery, session_start, crash_free_session. No bag contents, positions, or full saves.
No first-party crash reporter shipped in 1.0; platform store crash reports may still apply outside this form's developer collection.
frame_time_summary (emaMs, quality, samples, platform) only with analytics consent. No device id / IP / uid props.
Optional cloud sync mints/restores an anonymous Firebase Identity Toolkit uid locally; not used for advertising. Analytics payloads forbid uid/userId/deviceId/ip.
Optional cloud sync uploads a checksummed save snapshot (game progress). Local saves stay on-device; Autobackup excludes harbor_save_*.json and entitlement prefs.

purchases.processedBy: Google Play Billing / web checkout API
purchases.note: Platform processes IAP; Restore purchases recovers entitlements. Developer form does not claim user payment info collection.

androidBackup.reason: Save slots are AtomicFile-rotated and recovered in-app; Autobackup of a mid-write latest can corrupt both slots. Entitlements restore via Play Billing.

playConsoleChecklist: Data safety → Overview: Yes, collects/shares limited optional data; encryption in transit; deletion available
Declare App interactions + Diagnostics as optional, not shared, Analytics purpose, consent
Declare Device or other IDs only for optional anonymous cloud sync (App functionality)
Declare optional cloud save snapshot under App activity / other in-game progress
Do NOT declare name, email, phone, precise location, advertising ID for ads, or payment card info
Link privacy policy URL from listing.json
Confirm Autobackup excludes match release-hardening backupExcludes
